examples.en: She built bookshelves out of bricks and planks.
examples.zh: 她用砖和厚木板制作了书架。

examples.en: I knocked some bookshelves together from old planks.
examples.zh: 我用旧木板拼拼凑凑做了些书架。

examples.en: A glance along his bookshelves reveals a bewildering array of interests.
examples.zh: 扫一眼他的书架就可以看出他杂七杂八的兴趣爱好。
